rationale: A charge needs 2D6 to cover the gap. At 14 inches that is 1 in 36, and a failed charge wastes the unit's whole turn while leaving it in the open. At 5 inches it is 30 in 36. This exam puts the only chargeable enemy 14.5 inches away and checks the AI declares no charge at all — the cheapest possible probe of whether charge probability is priced or ignored.

assert.name: no charge was declared across a 14 inch gap

why_it_fails_today: Charge declaration order and odds are scored heuristically today; the AI declares a charge it cannot make when it has nothing else to do. D4's beam search over charge-declaration order is where a hopeless declaration gets priced against not declaring at all.
measured_2026_08_07: FAIL — this is the expected result until D4 lands.
